zh.title: 阿聯酋航空波音777德里鳥擊機鼻錐受損 旅客滯留17小時
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空波音777遭遇鳥擊致機鼻錐受損；旅客在德里滯留17小時，航機隔日上午返回杜拜
body: 根據Simple Flying的報導，阿聯酋航空一架波音777客機遭遇鳥擊，機鼻錐（nose cone）受損。
報導標題指出，事發後旅客在德里滯留17小時。
報導摘要指出，該架航機在隔日上午返回杜拜。
報導未說明鳥擊發生的具體時間、飛行階段、航班編號或是否有人受傷。
報導亦未交代機鼻錐受損的詳細程度、維修安排或後續調查情況。

en.title: Emirates Boeing 777 nose cone damaged in Delhi bird strike; passengers stranded 17 hours
en.summary: Emirates Boeing 777 nose cone damaged in a bird strike; passengers stranded 17 hours in Delhi; aircraft returned to Dubai the next morning
body: An Emirates Boeing 777 was damaged in a bird strike, with the aircraft's nose cone affected, according to Simple Flying.
The report's headline states passengers were stranded in Delhi for 17 hours after the bird strike.
The report's summary states the aircraft returned to Dubai the following morning.
The report does not specify when the bird strike occurred, the flight phase, the flight number, or whether anyone was injured.
The report also does not detail the extent of the nose cone damage, maintenance arrangements or any follow-up investigation.

zh.title: 私人飛機中止起飛偏離跑道 拉斯維加斯機場關閉兩跑道
zh.summary: Harry Reid International Airport中止起飛事件後關閉兩條跑道
body: Simple Flying 報導，一架私人飛機於 10 月 18 日在拉斯維加斯的 Harry Reid International Airport（LAS） 中止起飛後偏離跑道。報導列出的機型為 Dassault Falcon 50，註冊編號為 N200SG。機場其後關閉兩條跑道。
報導所述事件包括中止起飛、飛機偏離跑道，以及機場關閉兩條跑道；摘要以機型和註冊編號識別該機。事件地點為拉斯維加斯的 Harry Reid International Airport，報導提及的日期為 10 月 18 日。

en.title: Private Jet Veers Off Runway After Aborted Takeoff at Las Vegas Airport
en.summary: Harry Reid International Airport closed two runways after a private jet veered off during an aborted takeoff.
body: Simple Flying reported that a private jet aborted its takeoff and veered off the runway at Harry Reid International Airport (LAS) in Las Vegas on October 18. The aircraft was identified as a Dassault Falcon 50, registration N200SG. The airport closed two runways after the occurrence.

The report describes an aborted takeoff followed by the aircraft veering off the runway, and states that two airport runways were closed. It identifies the aircraft by model and registration and gives the location as Harry Reid International Airport in Las Vegas. The date stated in the report is October 18.
